reader.reads: Plato, Republic X 598a–c, in the Greek text of the public corpus, beside the registers' readings.

thesis.ru: Сократ спрашивает, подражает ли живопись сущему или являющемуся; Главкон отвечает, что она подражает представлению.
thesis.en: Socrates asks whether painting imitates reality or appearance; Glaucon answers that it imitates appearance.

conceptions.note: The register readings also discuss the painter’s knowledge and the distance of imitation from truth; this quotation establishes the question of appearance and the answer, while those further claims require the following passage.
